1. Summary and findings

ais_3u (coarse class): the loop selects mtq_fmr (Magnetorquers + fluid momentum loop), feasible, after 7 iteration(s). Methods: detumble = mtq, sun_acquisition = fmr, sun_referencing = fmr+mtq, nadir_pointing = fmr+mtq. Budget: 1.446 kg, 0.537 L. Best benchmark (catalogue actuators, same rule): mtq_rw, closest (not feasible), 0.393 kg — sun_acquisition: power_mean (power); sun_referencing: power_mean (power).

ais_img_3u (fine class): the loop selects mtq_fmr (Magnetorquers + fluid momentum loop), feasible, after 10 iteration(s). Methods: detumble = mtq, sun_acquisition = fmr, sun_referencing = fmr+mtq, nadir_pointing = fmr+mtq. Budget: 1.534 kg, 0.534 L. Best benchmark (catalogue actuators, same rule): mtq_rw, feasible, 0.996 kg.

2. Architecture and flow

The design loop sizes every actuator option to the case, flies every mission mode with every option in the SILS, converges the sizing, sensors and algorithms, selects the lightest of our solution families that passes, dispatches its flight configuration and verifies it by Monte Carlo and in soft OILS. The same flight software (C99 and Rust, one pseudocode contract) runs in every rung behind one byte-level HAL.

3. Nodes

Every step of the chain is a node with its inputs, outputs, parameters and rules in one registry (matlab_sils/data/pipeline/nodes.json; docs/NODES.md). The pipeline reads its parameters from it, so this table is what ran.

#nodestageruns inwhat it doesparametersrules
1caseinputfileThe customer case: orbit, mass properties, surfaces, requirements and budgets (adcs-case/1).—every requirement names its source (stated by the user, or UNCONFIRMED with a plan reference)
the case file is part of every cached run's key: a changed requirement re-flies the matrix
2catalogueinputfile + Python (tools/catalogue.py derives the modelling block)Bought actuators as their datasheets state them: CubeSpace, AAC Clyde Space and Rocket Lab reaction wheels, Tensor Tech control moment gyroscopes. One file per model with the datasheet numbers, the source URL and the model parameters derived from them (each derived value says how).vendors = CubeSpace, AAC Clyde Space, Rocket Lab, Tensor Techa number not on the datasheet is null in the datasheet block, never guessed
model parameters the engine needs but the datasheet omits (rotor inertia, friction, imbalance) are derived and marked derived, with the rule
RW, CMG and VSCMG are bought: they are selected from the catalogue, never sized by a law
3demanddesignRust (adcs-design::demand)What the case asks of an actuator: one orbit on the POP orbit at four held attitudes with the SILS torque models; peak disturbance, cyclic and secular momentum, weakest field, detumble and slew momentum.k_h = momentum margin: 2, or 1/(1 - req.hsat)
k_tau = 1.5		h_req = k_h x max(cyclic + secular per orbit, slew momentum)
tau_req = k_tau x max(peak disturbance, slew torque)
fine class when req.ake <= 0.05 deg (star tracker, precision gyro)
4size_mtqdesignRust (adcs-design::mtq)Our magnetorquer coils, sized: the largest of the dumping, momentum and detumble dipoles.floor_Am2 = 0.05
anchor = SYN-CT-1: mass 0.03 kg, 0.3 W per 0.45 Am2		m = max(2 tau_dist/(0.5 B_min), 2 h_secular/(0.3 B_mean T), h_detumble/(0.3 B_mean t_detumble/2))
the coils-only family carries the pointing-grade coil (at least twice the dumping dipole)
5size_fmrdesignRust (adcs-design::fmr, empump)Our fluid momentum loop, one ring per axis, designed with its electromagnetic DC conduction pump (no permanent magnet).electrode_current_max_A = 10
iron_flux_T = 1.2
fluid = galinstan
cruise_fraction = 0.4		grid over flow speed, bore, gap field and pump length; keep the least mass + lambda x steady power that meets h_req and tau_req
torque capacity = I_max B / b x 2 S A / L; coil m_cu = sqrt(lambda K)
6size_rcsdesignRust (adcs-design::rcs)Our N2O cold-gas RCS, 6 couples: thrust class and propellant tank.isp_budget_s = 60
thrust_classes_N = 0.005, 0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.1
meop_bar = 70		thrust: the smallest class above the couple the detumble and slew need
propellant: detumble + dumping over life, 1.2 margin
7select_rotordesignRust (adcs-design::catalogue)The benchmarks' momentum actuators chosen from the catalogue: for RW three orthogonal wheels, for CMG and VSCMG a four-unit 54.74 deg pyramid.rw_units = 3
cmg_units = 4
pyramid_deg = 54.74
per_unit_need = rw: h_max >= h_req x scale and torque >= tau_req x scale (three wheels, one per axis); cmg: h_max >= h_req/2 x scale and torque >= tau_req/2 x scale (a pyramid puts about two units on any axis); vscmg: as cmg; the rotor runs at half its momentum so its speed can move both ways
choose = the lightest model that meets the need; ties by steady power, then volume
selectable = a catalogue model whose datasheet states momentum, torque, mass and steady power (tools/catalogue.py)		when no model meets the need the largest is taken and the gap is reported (the loop cannot size it up)
an authority increase from the converge node raises the need, so the next model up is chosen
8size_sensorsdesignRust (adcs-design::size_all)The sensor set of every product: magnetometer, six sun sensors, gyro, GNSS, Earth sensor; the star tracker on the fine class or when knowledge asks for it.star_tracker = SYN-ST-1
st_heads_default = 2
gyro_fine = TRN-GYRO-P1
gyro_coarse = SYN-GYRO-1		gyro grade g: noise x g, mass and power / g (fibre-optic class below 1)
9budgetdesignRust (adcs-design::budget)Each family's product: mass, steady power and volume summed over every fitted unit.—units per fill = number of axes / spin axes / boresights; the six sun sensors count as one part
10matrixSILSRust engine + C flight software (adcs run)Every mission mode x actuator option x seed on the sized products; options that fail on performance also fly every algorithm of their slot.seeds = 1, 2
cache_key = scenario, product, parts, seed, flight-software build, case file
algorithm_candidates = detumble: bdot_gyro, bdot_mag, bdot_bangbang, genbdot_l1; sun_acquisition: sunspin_damped, sunspin_l1l2, sunspin_l1l2_e2, sunspin_deruiter2011, sun_boresight_celani2026; mtq_pointing: mtq_pd, mtq_lqr, mtq_smc, mtq_rate_damp, mtq_lovera2004, mtq_celani2015, mtq_avanzini2021, mtq_celani2026, mtq_tango2013; pointing: pid, lqr, smc, pid@bw2.5, pid@bw4		a run is scored against the case's requirements at run time
channels are deleted after scoring (the manifest is kept)
the coils-only laws of the magnetorquer literature review (docs/MTQ_LITERATURE.md) are candidates of their slots like every other law
11assessSILSPython (tools/pipeline.py)Per option: feasible on every seed? Each failing requirement classed; the best algorithm per option kept.classes = power*: power; ake*: knowledge; propellant*: propellant; otherwise: performance
violation = value / requirement - 1 (10 when not finite)		rank an option's variants by (not feasible, failing count, worst objective)
12tuneSILSRust engine + C flight software (through matrix)Bruni & Celani 2017 (P7) min-max gain selection: for a coils-only option that still fails on performance after every law of its slot has flown, every law is flown at every point of a gain grid, on extra seeds; each law keeps the gains whose worst seed is best, and assess then ranks the laws by that worst case.grids = mtq_pointing: mtq_gain_p: 0.25, 1, 4; mtq_gain_d: 0.25, 1, 4; sun_acquisition: spin_rate_dps: 2, 4, 6; ss_gain: 0.3, 1, 3
extra_seeds = 3, 4
actuators = mtq
objective = worst seed: (not feasible, failing count, objective)		mtq_gain_p / mtq_gain_d scale the proportional and rate gains of every magnetic pointing law (for Avanzini: lambda and k)
spin_rate_dps sets the commanded spin (Roldugin: wobble grows with it) and ss_gain the Sun-law gains
the grid is a derivative-free search as in the paper, coarse (3 x 3) to keep the matrix inside minutes
13convergedesignPython (tools/pipeline.py)The knob changes the failures call for; converged when nothing is left to change.scale_bounds = 0.5, 4.0
scale_up = 1.5
scale_down = 0.75
improvement_needed = 0.05
fmr_lambda_bounds_kg_W = 0.01, 3.0
fmr_flow_sigma_min_m_s = 5e-05
gyro_grade_min = 0.1
max_iterations = 24		performance: fly every algorithm of the slot, then (fluid loop) a quieter flow sensor /4, then authority x1.5; undone when the violation does not fall by 5 %
rate stability (fine class): gyro noise x0.3 down to x0.1; undone when it does not improve
knowledge: fit the star tracker on a coarse product
power, fluid loop: pump lambda x3 (not for RCS valve power); coils-only: coil authority x0.75; rotors: blocked (standby power is the floor)
mass over budget, closest solution family: lighter gyro, one star-tracker head, lambda /3, fluid-loop momentum x0.75 -- each undone and closed if it breaks a mode or raises the violation by more than 5 %
propellant: RCS x1.5
a part pushed up by one failure and down by another is frozen and reported as a conflict
14selectselectionPython (tools/pipeline.py)Scores every family (ours and the benchmarks) on the same modes and budget, then picks the minimum feasible solution; the benchmarks are ranked by the same rule as the comparison.feasible = every mode passes with a usable option on every seed, and mass <= req.mass, volume <= req.vol
rank_feasible = mass_kg, power_W, volume_L, simplicity
rank_infeasible = gap_count, mass_kg
select_role = solution
compare_role = benchmark		selected = the feasible solution family first in rank_feasible order (least mass, then power, then volume)
when no solution family is feasible the closest one is named with its gaps
benchmark = the same ranking over the benchmark families, reported beside the selection
15dispatchdispatchRust (adcs dispatch)The selected family's mission (detumble -> Sun acquisition -> nadir), its adcs-fswcfg/1 blob, the converged products; C and Rust checked bit-identical.duration_orbits = detumble + acquisition + nadirthe C and Rust flight software must agree bit for bit
16certifyverificationPython (tools/floquet.py)Celani 2026 (P8) method: Floquet multipliers of the coils-only nadir loop linearised about the reference, with the gains the coils-only family dispatches and the magnetic field along one orbit; all |mu| < 1 certifies local exponential stability of the periodic loop.field = aligned dipole, 7.94e15 T m^3, in the orbit frame
frame = reference body frame from the mission's own nadir phase (truth attitude)
steps_per_orbit = 2000		theta_dot = w, J w_dot = Gamma(t) tau(theta, w) with Gamma = I - b b^T; gyroscopic and gravity-gradient terms left out, as in the papers' averaging analyses
a boresight law leaves the rotation about its boresight free: one multiplier stays at 1 by design
17mcverificationRust engineMonte Carlo of the dispatched mission with the case's dispersions (truth dispersed, flight software nominal). It feeds back: a requirement that fails in any dispersed run is a failure the loop must fix.runs = 12
robustness_passes = 3		dispersions as asils.campaign.draw
every requirement metric must pass in every run; otherwise, for the selected family:
power -> pump with more copper (lambda x3) and the lighter-pump lever closed
performance -> the family's authority x1.5 and its authority-down lever closed
knowledge -> the star tracker on a coarse product
the loop then runs on from the new knobs (sizing, matrix, converge, select, dispatch, mc) up to robustness_passes times
18family_missionsverificationRust engine + C and Rust flight softwareEvery one of our solution families, selected or not (coils only, coils + fluid loop, coils + fluid loop + RCS), dispatched and flown as the full mission (detumble -> Sun acquisition -> nadir) with its best methods from the loop, in C and Rust, and by Monte Carlo, so each family's behaviour is on record beside the selection.role = solution
monte_carlo_runs = as node mc		the selected family reuses its dispatch and mc outputs
a family that is not feasible is still flown: its gaps show in its mission metrics
C and Rust must agree bit for bit for every family
19soft_oilsverificationRust engine + QEMU (Cortex-M4F)The dispatched mission with the flight software as firmware (C and Rust) beside its SILS run; exact instruction timing and bus latency.obc_mhz = 168
cpi = 1.25
i2c_khz = 400
spi_mhz = 1
can_kbps = 1000		a latency >= the control step counts as an overrun
a missing instruction count stops the run
20reportreportPythonThe design ledger per case and the V&V report (HTML and PDF).—every table is generated from the stored node outputs, never typed

4. Actuator catalogue (datasheets)

Reaction wheels, CMGs and VSCMGs are bought, so the benchmarks fly real products: the select_rotor node takes the lightest catalogue model that meets the case's per-unit momentum and torque (three wheels; a four-unit CMG pyramid, two units per axis). We design only the magnetorquers, the fluid loop and the RCS. Numbers are the vendors'; a model whose datasheet lacks momentum, torque, mass or steady power is listed but not selectable. Values the engine needs and datasheets omit (rotor inertia, friction, imbalance) are derived with the rules in each file (tools/catalogue.py, docs/CATALOGUE.md).

6. Design loop per case: every configuration compared

ais_3u: selected mtq_fmr — Magnetorquers + fluid momentum loop (feasible)

Converged after 7 iteration(s); knowledge class coarse; sensors: magnetometer, sun_sensors, gyro, gnss, earth_sensor. Demand on the POP orbit: peak disturbance 5.635e-07 N m (sun), stored momentum requirement 0.001466 N m s, torque requirement 5.757e-05 N m, weakest field 19.76 µT, detumble momentum 0.00733 N m s.

iterknobsoptions feasibleselectionchanges for the next iterationblocked
1laws as written1/25mtq (closest (not feasible))nadir_pointing/fmr+mtq: power -> electromagnetic pump with more copper (lambda 0.1 -> 0.3 kg/W)
nadir_pointing/mtq: fly every mtq_pointing algorithm
sun_acquisition/mtq: fly every sun_acquisition algorithm
sun_referencing/mtq: fly every mtq_pointing algorithm		16
2pump λ 0.3 kg/W4/25mtq_fmr (feasible)nadir_pointing/mtq: tune every mtq_pointing law's gains, min over the gains of the worst seed (Bruni & Celani 2017)
sun_acquisition/mtq: tune every sun_acquisition law's gains, min over the gains of the worst seed (Bruni & Celani 2017)
sun_referencing/mtq: tune every mtq_pointing law's gains, min over the gains of the worst seed (Bruni & Celani 2017)		18

Why the loop stopped (nothing left that a knob can change):

  • detumble/rcs: power fails at the sized authority (rcs); the part's standby power is the floor
  • mtqp: more authority did not reduce the performance violation (16.2 -> 29.7); kept at x2.25
  • nadir_pointing/cmg+mtq: power fails at the sized authority (cmg); the part's standby power is the floor
  • nadir_pointing/cmg+rcs: power fails at the sized authority (cmg); the part's standby power is the floor
  • nadir_pointing/fmr+rcs: power is the thrusters' valve power (RCS dumping), not the pump
  • nadir_pointing/rw+mtq: power fails at the sized authority (rw); the part's standby power is the floor
  • nadir_pointing/rw+rcs: power fails at the sized authority (rw); the part's standby power is the floor
  • nadir_pointing/vscmg+mtq: power fails at the sized authority (vscmg); the part's standby power is the floor
  • nadir_pointing/vscmg+rcs: power fails at the sized authority (vscmg); the part's standby power is the floor
  • sun_acquisition/cmg: power fails at the sized authority (cmg); the part's standby power is the floor
  • sun_acquisition/rw: power fails at the sized authority (rw); the part's standby power is the floor

Coils only (mtq), how it behaves. It is kept as designed; coils-only nadir pointing is to be improved later from the owner's references.
  • Detumble: 39.24 min in the mode test and 40.49 min in the mission (requirement 284 min); it passes in 100 % of the Monte Carlo runs.
  • Sun acquisition (Sun-spin, sunspin_damped@spin_rate_dps=4,ss_gain=0.3): the coils spin the body up about the Sun line and bring the power face towards the Sun, so coils alone are largely sufficient here. They do not meet the case's line, though: the power face within 20 deg after 93.09 min (requirement 95 min), and a 95th-percentile Sun angle of 24.34 deg over the last half orbit (limit 20 deg).
  • Sun referencing: 84.68 deg (p99.73) with mtq_celani2026@mtq_gain_p=0.25,mtq_gain_d=1; the coils cannot hold a three-axis Sun attitude.
  • Nadir pointing is where the coils fall short. From a settled start the best law (mtq_celani2026@mtq_gain_p=4,mtq_gain_d=0.25) holds the line of sight to 3.728 deg (p99.73) against 10 deg. In the full mission nadir is commanded while the Sun-spin is still turning, and the coils cannot take that momentum out in time: 33.72 deg.

7. Magnetorquer-only literature

Sixteen magnetorquer-only papers were reviewed (literature_review_v2.pptx). Every law that the accessible text specifies is now in the flight software, in C and Rust (bit for bit identical), in the pseudocode, and in the registry as a candidate of its slot: Lovera & Astolfi 2004, Celani 2015, Avanzini et al. 2021, Celani 2026 (boresight, for the payload and for the power face), TANGO's frozen-Riccati LQR (flown), de Ruiter 2011, and the P11 → P5 chain already in place (UPMSat-2 spin-up, He et al. Sun spin). Bruni & Celani's min–max tuning is node tune; Celani's Floquet certificate is node certify. The paper-by-paper record, including what was not implemented and why, is docs/MTQ_LITERATURE.md.

11. Soft OILS

Every scenario flown twice on the engine: SILS (C flight software in-process) and soft OILS (the flight software compiled for the OBC, arm-none-eabi-gcc -mcpu=cortex-m4 -mfloat-abi=hard, running as firmware on QEMU mps2-an386 behind adcs-link/1). In soft OILS each command reaches the actuators only after the OBC's sensor reads, its execution and its CAN frames; the execution is the step's exact instruction count (QEMU plugin) × CPI 1.25 / 168 MHz. 105 of 107 requirement verdicts agree between SILS and soft OILS over 40 scenarios; runs are deterministic.

14. Open items

  • Bang-bang B-dot (fixed): pure sign switching limit-cycled around the 0.5 deg/s exit rate in 4 of 12 seeds with or without OBC latency; a boundary layer (4 x the B-dot gain inside it) detumbles 12 of 12 at 0, 4 and 8 ms. C, Rust, MATLAB and pseudocode updated.
  • Rate stability (imaging): relaxed by the owner from 0.001 to 0.005 deg/s (18 arcsec/s, ~0.5 m smear in a 10 ms exposure at 550 km). At 0.001 deg/s it was set by gyro noise for every actuator (0.0025-0.004 deg/s with TRN-GYRO-P1) and needed a fibre-optic-class gyro (0.6 kg); at 0.005 deg/s the catalogue gyro holds it. The ADCS budget is 1.6 kg / 1.0 L (1U of the 3U; ceiling 1.7 kg).
  • Fluid loop fine pointing: limited by the loop's flow sensor, not the pump. The converged imaging design carries a 0.125 mm/s (1 sigma) flow sensor; this is a requirement on the in-house sensor. One star-tracker head instead of two breaks nadir pointing, so both stay.
  • Engine vs MATLAB on fine_hold_rw_rcs rate stability: 0.0056 against 0.0036 deg/s (ratio 1.56, as before the relaxation); the new 0.005 deg/s line now falls between them, so this verdict disagrees. The gap is the wheel-plus-RCS model, not the requirement.
  • Sun spin: 17 of 24 seeds pass with and without the OBC; failures are Sun-spin entry with the Sun near the XY plane tripping the 1 deg/s exit guard during the L2 precession transient -- a tuning trade (fsw.sun_spin_perp_out_dps, fsw.sun_spin_dwell_out_s).
  • Coils only (mtq): largely sufficient for detumble and for Sun acquisition by Sun-spin (the power face is brought towards the Sun, though not within the cases' 95 min / 20 deg line), and not sufficient for nadir pointing, above all from the spinning state the mission hands over. Kept as designed; the owner will improve coils-only nadir pointing from the literature later.
  • Bought against designed (both cases, same budget of 1.6 kg and 1.0 L): on ais_img_3u three CubeSpace CW0017 wheels are feasible at 1.0 kg against our fluid loop's 1.6 kg, so the lightest configuration overall is a benchmark; the fluid loop is selected because the selection is among our solutions, and its 0.6 kg is the price of not buying wheels. On ais_3u every rotor fails the 0.5 W orbit-average power (three CW0017 draw 0.9 W steady) and the fluid loop, feasible at 1.45 kg, is the only one that passes. The Tensor Tech CMG cluster fails power in both cases on its whole-ADCS datasheet figure (4 W upper bound).
  • Catalogue data: the vendor sites were not reachable from the build environment. CubeSpace Gen2, Rocket Lab RW-0.01, RW3-0.06, RW3-1.0 and Tensor Tech ADCS100/400 numbers were read from the full datasheets (distributor mirror); AAC Clyde Space RW222/RW400, Rocket Lab RW-0.03 and Tensor Tech CMG-10m from search excerpts. AAC Clyde Space models lack mass or power on what could be read, so they are listed but not selectable; confirm with the vendors before a buy decision.
  • Soft OILS models the OBC's CPU and buses; real OILS still needs the board target (fsw/targets/<board>/main.c: UART/Ethernet, clock, linker script, modelled on fsw/targets/qemu-mps2) and --realtime on adcs-link/1.
